verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single what's-new line saying users can build agents, via chat or a visual builder, that run proactively on triggers they set. That implies automated workflows that run more than once, but it never documents time-based or recurring schedules, and it is unclear whether this belongs to Superhuman Mail or the broader suite. Auto Labels, Auto Archive and send-at-best-time are event-driven or one-off actions, not schedules. missing for 10: explicit recurring/time-based schedule triggers (e.g., daily/weekly cron-style jobs), documentation of trigger types, confirmation it applies to Mail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
